name: Average Day In America (YARD DEALER)
desc:
-The old game page has returned
Roblox moderation seems like they will never bring the other game back we are sorry-

An open world stereotypical America where you can work minimum wage, or live a life of crime and violence in an open world sandbox, taking place in the fictional US state, "Verdania"

The game has a steep learning curve!

MELEE CONTROLS
R - Heavy
E - Light
F - Shove
M1 - Swing
C - Block
Q - Finish

MISC
Backspace - Give item to nearest player
/drop + amount | In order to take out physical cash to hand to people
